required_evidence: Successful fresh default-worker pilot with artifacts and ordinary-arrival observations
All participating services agree on enabled configuration and roots before releasing owned pause
At least one complete reconciliation cycle with no cycle errors; inventory completion alone does not pass
Oldest pending receipt and unreconciled scope ages, with any sampling limitations explicit
Ordinary default arrivals, measured queue delay below stop threshold
Maintenance outstanding never above seven and no execution-uncertain reservations
Duplicate locator traversal reported separately from unique project coverage
stop_actions: Pause new catalog admission with an owned pause, without overwriting another operator pause
Retain admitted jobs, receipts, ledger and historical pilot records
Allow admitted work to drain and inspect failure evidence
Do not restart RQ1.x or reset Redis
execution: Existing wepp1 rq-worker via wctl docker compose exec -T rq-worker /opt/venv/bin/python; script/evidence under /wc1/query-catalog-validation/20261106/general-observation-01
observer_loss: Parent operator monitors heartbeat at most every60seconds. On process/SSH loss or stale heartbeat beyond60seconds, set owned pause with NX immediately; preserve other owner. Any gap invalidates uninterrupted coverage until explicitly reviewed. SIGTERM/INT/sample alarm invoke finally pause. SIGKILL/host loss cannot be caught; do not claim automatic fail-closed heartbeat enforcement.
completion_fields: independently retained artifact-acceptance.json for same cycle
age_coverage: Collector retains ages for cursor-pending and admitted scopes plus cycle elapsed. It does not establish global oldest receipt; explicit independent coverage acceptance required or gate stays open.
deadline_action: Pause own admission and retain incomplete outcome; absent ordinary arrivals or artifact/age proof never pass.
authorization_preconditions: Concrete expected_configuration, host_runtime_images and fixed absolute_deadline replace nulls before state authorized_observation
Fresh evidence directory and exclusive observer-start.json; no in-place retry
Any admission pause after release invalidates uninterrupted observation
Fresh target cycle and measured ordinary jobs enqueued after activation; scheduled reconciler ticks excluded from arrival acceptance
